name: Machimiya Tsubasa
source:
A boyish girl who is admired by female students due to her prince-like atmosphere. She is a good-looking girl with a fresh personality, and it is not unusual when her junior confesses to her despite being the same-sex.
Around strangers, she is kind and considerate and always play the part of the prince, but inside she wants to be treated like a normal girl. 
Despite this, she keeps her true feelings to herself as to not disappoint the girls who adore her. She has no experience in sex, but she has amount of knowledge expected from a modern schoolgirl, and she masturbates a few time each month.
